record.question: Who invented Mobile Phone?
record.explanation: Cooper's 2008 oral history documents the Motorola handheld portable-phone project and the 1973 demonstration. Cooper is the uniquely relevant listed contributor; show that his team developed a handheld cellular phone, not all earlier mobile radio telephony. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://archive.computerhistory.org/resources/access/text/2012/08/102702037-05-01-acc.pdf Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
